test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Generally, a cycle has an seat and handle along with two pedals and a bell, sometimes a carrier too.

options.text: a bell, sometimes a carrier too.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the article ""**an**" before the term "**seat**."
 
• The correct article to use with the word "seat" is **"a"** because **"seat" **does not start with a vowel sound.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be "**a seat and handle along**".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Generally, a cycle has **a **seat and handle along with two pedals and a bell, sometimes a carrier too."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a bell, sometimes a carrier too." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "with two pedals and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "seat and handle along"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
